jobs.purpose: Method A Pandey-Kumar Section 4.3 Job-1 Standard-Element Formulation Test: Plane-stress linear elastic pre-analysis (*STATIC, DIRECT) on 3,923 physical elements (3,814 CPS4R quads, 109 CPS3 tris, 4,040 nodes), 1-CPU serial, 2-step loading to u_y = 1.5 mm, generating authentic standard-element donor ODB for native MISESERI error evaluation and comparison against Fig. 15b.

acceptance.pk_sec43_standard_job1: Abaqus 2023 single-rank serial solve completes Stage B Job-1 standard plane-stress element simulation on 3,923 elements to u_y = 1.5 mm, producing donor ODB with native MISESERI across load increments for evaluation against Fig. 15b.

hypothesis: A standard plane-stress element formulation (CPS4R/CPS3) produces a dual-branch elevated-error MISESERI band along both the notch-to-hole path and the secondary flank-to-edge path in the Section 4.3 holed plate.
